evidence: The author ran pgdbf on a schedule during migration and said it worked great.

evidence_sources.author: kstrauser
evidence_sources.excerpt: For a while we had to run it as a cron job so that people could to data entry in an old VFP app but others could run fast reports on our web app with a postgres backend. It wasn't pretty, but it worked great and helped us get off that ancient stack.

source_story_title: Microsoft killed FoxPro in 2007. Anyway, here's FoxPro revived
